content: LHM polling: create Hardware.Computer(), set IsCpuEnabled/IsGpuEnabled=True (Phase 1 only needs CPU+GPU), Open(), each poll call hardware.Update() on all hardware and SubHardware recursively. Filter sensors: HardwareType in {Cpu, GpuNvidia, GpuAmd, GpuIntel} AND SensorType.Temperature. GPU types: GpuNvidia, GpuAmd, GpuIntel per HardwareType enum. SubHardware must be traversed for nested sensors. Admin elevation often required for CPU temps.
